title: Sharing seeds at a neighborhood swap
titleZh: 社區種子交換會的規則
passage: Welcome to the neighborhood seed swap. The packets on the main table are for sharing. You may take two, even if you did not bring seeds today. If you bring seeds from your own garden, write the plant name and the month you collected them on the envelope. Then leave it at the check-in desk, not on the table. Our volunteers check the label before the packets go on the table. When a plant name is missing, the packet goes into a separate box for later identification. If you want an envelope for seeds you’ll bring next month, there are blank ones at the exit.
passageZh: 歡迎來到社區種子交換會。主桌上的種子袋可供大家分享。即使你今天沒帶種子，也可以拿兩袋。如果你帶來自家花園的種子，請在信封上寫植物名稱和收集的月份，再把信封留在報到櫃檯，不要直接放上主桌。種子袋放上主桌前，志工會先查看標示。沒有植物名稱的種子袋會另外放進一個盒子，待日後辨識。下個月打算帶種子的人，可以在出口拿空信封。
